sections.title: Verbs That Break the Pattern
sections.content: The common verbs are the irregular ones, and they break in two predictable ways. Some are odd only in the yo form and regular everywhere else — hacer → hago, salir → salgo. Others change their stem in every form except nosotros and vosotros, exactly as querer does: jugar → juego, preferir → prefiero.

sections.title: Odd in the yo form only
Stem-changing, like querer
rows: ir → voy, vas, va, vamos, vais, van

items.spanish: Siempre llevo mi cámara cuando salgo.
items.english: I always take my camera when I go out.

items.spanish: Yo juego al fútbol casi todos los domingos.
items.english: I play football almost every Sunday.

items.spanish: Yo prefiero leer y escuchar música en casa.
items.english: I prefer reading and listening to music at home.

sections.content: 'Ir' is the one to learn whole — 'voy' looks nothing like its infinitive. It is worth it: 'voy a' plus a verb is how Spanish talks about the future, which is Lesson 17.
